title: Khoe languages - Wikipedia
text: The nearest relative of the Khoe family may be the extinct Kwadi language of Angola. This larger group, for which pronouns and some basic vocabulary have been reconstructed, is called Khoe–Kwadi.

title: Khoe–Kwadi languages - Wikipedia
text: The Khoe–Kwadi languages are a family consisting of the Khoe languages of southern Africa and the poorly attested extinct Kwadi language of Angola. The relationship has been worked out by Tom Güldemann, Edward Elderkin, and Anne-Maria Fehn.

text: Las lenguas khoe o kxoe son una pequeña familia de lenguas khoisán hablada en el sur de África, constituyen el grupo autóctono no bantú más importante del sur de África.
